runner: Existing Playwright one worker; real Chromium and xterm, synthetic native IPC.
environment: Windows shared PC, owned source fixture; no user profiles, CLI or daemon. Frozen a02913d module served through a Vite pre-load hook for baseline only; all other source and test bytes identical.

cases.scenario: IME01-08 in bilingual case documents: composition flags, active composition, app shortcuts, search, Shift+Enter and browser composition commit.
cases.entryPoint: Actual DOM keyboard/composition events and Chromium Input.imeSetComposition routed through main.ts, xterm and existing input queue
cases.expectedBehavior: No app action during composition; exact committed Korean text once; ordinary shortcuts and UTF-8 input preserved.
cases.oracle: DOM layout/focus/search visibility, exact session_write sequence and existing conversation RPC assertions.
cases.sensitivityReason: Review frozen-module baseline and candidate browser reports directly; do not fabricate engineering-run receipts or claim physical IME from injected events.

exclusions: No CLI changes; CLI-owned defects deferred to next version.
Physical Windows IME, actual WebView2/CLI, final Core pairing and full release acceptance remain separate.
